decisions.title: Agent runtime of record
decisions.decision: Adopt a declared split between the two agent runtimes: ariadex owns interactive long-running developer sessions, while sisyphusfy owns headless per-task loops with independent verification. Each runtime is registered in projects.json and ships its own profile; the split is a workspace-level policy so the two runtimes are not interchangeable and shared code is forbidden across them without an explicit supersede.

decisions.title: Self-hosted identity provider
decisions.decision: Adopt Zitadel as the self-hosted identity provider, run as a shared workspace runtime on jenkins-local, and exposed to product repositories as the single workspace SSO seam.
decisions.policy_boundary: The shared identity provider covers internal workspace products only. The public GitHub Pages catalog (lileililiwen-site and any sibling published as a static site) remains excluded from shared login and must not consume workspace SSO, shared analytics, or any cross-product identity data; that exclusion is restated from the root HANDOFF ownership table and is the binding interpretation of this decision.

decisions.title: Capability registry home
decisions.decision: Split the capability registry between two owners. platform-contracts owns the entry schema (the shape of a capability declaration). workspace-governance owns the registered instances (the live records of which projects declare which capabilities, kept next to projects.json).
decisions.policy_boundary: Capability entry schemas are owned by platform-contracts; registered capability instances are owned by workspace-governance. Consumers must read the schema from platform-contracts and the instances from this repository; the two are never merged into a single file.

decisions.title: Crate publication mode
decisions.decision: Publish the rust-platform-libs crates to crates.io instead of vendoring them as path dependencies. The repository is Apache-2.0 so the legal preconditions for public publication are satisfied; consumer adoption migrates off path dependencies only after the new registry-publication change lands.
